facts.text: Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Times Square and New York City.
facts.excerpt: Soak in Times Square and New York City views from floor-to-ceiling windows in stylish rooms that offer a residential feel through modern design and timeless style.

facts.text: Corner suites have sofas, deep soaking tubs and furnished balconies.
facts.excerpt: Corner suites feature sofas, deep soaking tubs, and furnished balconies, offering unparalleled views of Times Square and the midtown skyline.

facts.text: Connecting rooms can add a second and third bedroom to a suite.
facts.excerpt: Connecting rooms are also available to add a 2nd and 3rd bedroom to your Suite.

facts.text: The hotel has three dining experiences developed by Michelin-starred Chef John Fraser.
facts.excerpt: three distinct dining experiences developed by Michelin-starred Chef John Fraser

facts.text: The Terrace and Outdoor Gardens is Chef John Fraser's modern brasserie with a seasonal menu that emphasizes locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: The Terrace and Outdoor Gardens is Chef John Fraser’s modern brasserie where a seasonal menu marries the innovation of contemporary cooking and American culinary traditions, all while emphasizing locally sourced ingredients

facts.text: The Terrace and Outdoor Gardens offers many vegetable-forward dishes alongside brasserie classics.
facts.excerpt: Brasserie classics share space with a wide variety of vegetable-forward offerings, a signature of Chef Fraser’s style.

facts.text: Paradise Club is the hotel's entertainment venue, with ticketed cabaret-style dinner shows and immersive theater.
facts.excerpt: Open for a selection of ticketed cabaret-style dinner shows, immersive theater, and for private events

facts.text: Paradise Club has nightlife programming every Friday and Saturday.
facts.excerpt: Paradise Club nightlife programming every Friday and Saturday

facts.text: Paradise Club admits guests 21 and over with valid identification only.
facts.excerpt: 21+ with valid form of identification only.

facts.text: The Lobby Bar has custom bleached leather armchairs and ivory hand-tufted silk area rugs.
facts.excerpt: All-white accent furniture including custom bleached leather armchairs and ivory hand- tufted silk area rugs offer luxurious respite from the bustling scene outside.

facts.text: The Lobby Bar serves coffee, cocktails and light bites daily.
facts.excerpt: Lobby Bar, serving coffee, cocktails, and light bites open daily

facts.text: The gym is open 24 hours and has an outdoor wraparound wellness deck with views of Times Square and midtown.
facts.excerpt: the cutting-edge gym, which is open 24 hours and features an outdoor wraparound wellness deck with view of Times Square and midtown.

facts.text: Use of the 24-hour fitness facilities is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary use of the 24-hour fitness facilities

facts.text: High-speed wireless internet is complimentary throughout the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed wireless internet access throughout the hotel

facts.text: The hotel offers room service.
facts.excerpt: Room Service

facts.text: Mobility accessible rooms are available for certain room types.
facts.excerpt: Mobility accessible rooms available for certain room types

facts.text: The hotel has built-in junket floors for press junkets and for television and movie filming.
facts.excerpt: Built-in junket floors to accommodate press junkets, television and movie filming

facts.text: Rockefeller Center is described by the hotel as steps away.
facts.excerpt: Steps from The Times Square EDITION, Rockefeller Center offers shopping, seasonal art installations, tours of NBC Studios

facts.text: From the 50th Street subway station on 8th Avenue, the walk to the hotel is five minutes.
facts.excerpt: Walk from subway exit to the hotel is 5 minutes.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the area's first luxury hotel.
facts.excerpt: the area’s first luxury hotel
